analogy.rationale: The annotated target PPARG is a nuclear receptor with low expression in most of these cell lines, so methyltransferase inhibitors acting through PPARG should elicit little transcriptional response; PPAR agonists/antagonists share the same receptor pathway, while other methyltransferase and general transcriptional/translational inhibitors may show weak overlapping stress signatures.
